text:
Mia Chen: Observed sudden p95+ p99 latency spike for hosted API in us-west-2 starting ~23:40 UTC, correlates with burst of 1.2M tokens/min.
Samir Gupta: @Mia can you share the alert and dashboard links?
Mia Chen: https://grafana.redwood/company/dashboard/abc latency panel
Mia Chen: p95 from 120ms -> 2.8s, p99 to 7.4s. Queue depth climbed from 3->85 on routing shards. Error rates stayed low.
Priya Rao: Interesting — any recent runtime change? kernel selection tweak rolled earlier today? 
Jonathan Lee: We rolled kernel heuristic v2 at 22:50, it favors cudnn kernels for short sequences; fallback path still there.
Priya Rao: Could be batching mismatch + KV cache misses. Check kvcache hit rate for tenants hitting high seq.
Mia Chen: kvcache hit-rate for the top 5 tenants dropped from 88% -> 45% at spike window. Logs attached:
Mia Chen: ```
KVCacheEvict tenant=acct-42 evicted=5120 reason=memory_pressure
KVCacheMiss tenant=acct-42 key=dlk_... latency=0.2ms
``` 
Samir Gupta: @deploy-bot show recent deploys to hosted runtime
deploy-bot: Deploy: eng-runtime v2024.8.17-kerheuristics rolled at 22:50 by jlee
Priya Rao: That lines up. Proposed triage steps:
- revert kernel heuristic to baseline on a small pool
- check if batching sampler is oversharding (small batches -> more context switches)
- verify rate limiter per-tenant fanout didn't change
Mia Chen: I profiled one affected instance; flamegraph points to scheduler spin time during batch assembly (~30% CPU spent on batching path). Snapshot:
Mia Chen: ```
# top functions
batch_assembler::assemble 30.2%
kv_cache::fetch 12.1%
kernel_selector::select 8.3%
``` 
Jonathan Lee: The new heuristic adds a fast-path that skips assembly coalescing when seq_len < 64. If load has lots of short and long mixed requests, we may get increased fragmentation.
Samir Gupta: Could noisy tenant (acct-42) be dominating queues? Any rate-limiter logs?
Mia Chen: Rate limiter shows acct-42 had a sudden conn ramp + many parallel streams. We have per-tenant burst cap but fanout allows parallel up to 20. Effective queueing increase.
Priya Rao: Quick mitigation: 1) throttle parallel streams for heavy tenants -> drop fanout to 8 for acct-42, 2) pin that tenant to fallback kernel variant (safe path), 3) prewarm kvcache with recent prefixes.
Jonathan Lee: I'll push canary rollback of kernel heuristic to 3 nodes now. Priya can you enact tenant fanout rule? Samir monitor p99.
Priya Rao: Doing: `./infractl rate-limit set --tenant acct-42 --parallel 8 --reason "triage 1719001234"`
infra-bot: Rate limit update queued. Apply on 12 hosts.
Mia Chen: After applying throttles + canary rollback, p95 dropped to 180ms and p99 to 420ms within 6 minutes. Queue depth stabilized ~5-7.
Samir Gupta: Nice. Can we gather more profile traces to understand batching fragmentation? Schedule a perf run for mixed short/long workload.
Jonathan Lee: Agreed. I'll open a follow-up ticket with traces and config diffs. We should also add a regression test for mixed workload to CI.
Mia Chen: Filed: https://issues.redwood/company/INF-7893 perf test + kernel heuristic guardrails
Samir Gupta: Thanks all. Marking incident as mitigated. We'll keep this open for root-cause analysis.
